introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.p1: This privacy policy explains how Gift Planner collects, uses, and protects users' personal data.
introduction.p2: Gift Planner is committed to complying with applicable data protection regulations, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

dataController.title: Data Controller
dataController.p1: The data controller responsible for personal data collected through Gift Planner is:

dataCollected.title: Data Collected
dataCollected.p1: When using Gift Planner, the following data may be collected:
dataCollected.account: Information required to create and manage an account, including email address and authentication information.
dataCollected.giftLists: Information related to gifts, lists, and content created by the user within the application.
dataCollected.technical: Technical information required for service operation, such as technical logs or connection information.

purposes.title: Purposes of Processing
purposes.p1: Collected data is used for the following purposes:
purposes.accountManagement: Create, manage, and secure user accounts.
purposes.serviceProvision: Provide Gift Planner features and store user data.
purposes.security: Prevent fraudulent use and ensure service security.

authentication.title: Authentication
authentication.p1: Gift Planner uses an authentication system designed to secure access to user accounts.
authentication.p2: Access tokens are used to authenticate requests. Refresh tokens may be stored in a secure cookie to maintain user sessions.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.p1: Gift Planner only uses cookies required for service operation, including maintaining user authentication.
cookies.p2: These cookies are not used for advertising or commercial tracking purposes.

storage.title: Data Storage and Security
storage.p1: Personal data is stored on secure servers provided by our hosting provider.
storage.p2: Gift Planner implements technical and organizational measures designed to protect data against unauthorized access, loss, or alteration.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.p1: Data is retained for as long as necessary to provide the service and comply with applicable legal obligations.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.p1: Under the GDPR, users have the following rights:
rights.access: Right to access their personal data.
rights.deletion: Right to request deletion of personal data.
rights.restriction: Right to request restriction of processing.
rights.portability: Right to data portability where applicable.
